definitions.explanation: A person assigned to relay information and coordinate communication between groups, departments, or individuals.

examples.japanese: {連絡係|れんらくがかり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pass the message to the contact person.

examples.japanese: ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連絡係|れんらくがかり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}された。
examples.english: I was assigned to be the class liaison.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連絡係|れんらくがかり}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: As the event liaison, I have to notify all participants of the schedule change.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧ (contact, communication) and {係|がかり} (person in charge). Common in schools, workplaces, and organizations where someone is designated to relay messages and coordinate communication between groups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連絡係|れんらくがかり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as liaison
- {連絡係|れんらくがかり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}される: to be put in charge of communications
- ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連絡係|れんらくがかり}: class contact person
- {連絡係|れんらくがかり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact the liaison person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: point of contact, counter — the designated person or office for inquiries
- ⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: person in charge — broader, the person responsible for a task or area
- コーディネーター: coordinator — loanword, implies broader organizational responsibilities
